Procolored printer software downloads contained malware

Repository: N/A

Attribution: Unknown
Component: Driver
Language: multiple
Cause: compromised distribution

User Impact: 1000
Domain: procolored.com (product host)
Artifact Type: binary archive
Insertion Phase: distribution

Synopsis

Procolored shipped printer companion software through USB media and official website download links that led to infected Mega-hosted packages. Cameron Coward first found Floxif on vendor-supplied media while reviewing a V11 Pro DTO printer; G DATA then confirmed malware in official downloads for six product lines. The website packages contained XRedRAT and SnipVex, enabling remote control, keylogging, screenshots, file manipulation, and clipboard cryptocurrency theft before Procolored removed the downloads around May 8, 2025.
